lines.vo: Why do your muscles get stronger on the days you don't train?
That's not lazy. That's recovery doing the building.
Dre finishes a heavy session and marks tomorrow as rest in his Fit and Strong Tracker.
lines.cap: Dre finishes a heavy session and marks tomorrow as rest in his Fit & Strong Tracker.

lines.vo: Here's what's going on inside his arms.
Lifting is the signal. The rebuilding happens afterwards.
In one classic study, muscle building roughly doubled a day after training, and was nearly back to normal by thirty six hours.
lines.cap: In one classic study, muscle building roughly doubled a day after training, and was nearly back to normal by 36 hours.

lines.vo: Train hard every day with no break, and you never give it time to finish.
So a planned rest day isn't skipping. It's part of the plan.
Train, rest, repeat. That's how you stay on track.
